# Tajaran
The Tajaran are a species of humanoid omnivorous mammals that outwardly resemble Earth's felines. They come from Adhomai, a planet with a varied climate and one of a pair of Earth-like worlds orbiting the binary stars S'rendarr and Messa.
## Roleplay Guidelines
- Follow the naming scheme. Give your character a personal name and use the name of their house as the surname. Example: Tek'Eraya Kaytam. - Speak of yourself in the third person, except when talking to your kin in Siik'tajr. - Play out the culture of your subspecies and your bond to your house, or your life as a house exile. - Be polite and try not to swear. - Be very selective about physical contact. Do not let strangers touch or hug you. You have every right to complain or to put the offender in their place. - Address other crew members informally. Formal address is purely a quirk of other languages and makes no sense to a Tajara. - Keep clean. Wash at the first opportunity if you have soiled yourself, your clothes or your gear, and keep your workplace tidy.
## Homeworld
Unlike most known Earth-like planets, Adhomai has relatively little water. Land covers about 61% of the surface as a single supercontinent, while its bodies of water are split between salt and fresh, their salinity depending less on their size than on nearby volcanic activity. The Western and Eastern hemispheres are separated by the largest group of lakes on the planet, stretching from the South Pole to the North Pole in an uneven band. The largest of them, Etari'Ton, is really a group of merged lakes whose borders, shifted by tectonic plates, became the Etari Archipelago, the planet's best-known landmark. It is the only large body of water on the planet classed as a "world ocean". Adhomai's climate runs from hot deserts and rare tropics at the equator, through cold tundra in the middle latitudes, to unbroken glaciers at the poles.
## Culture
The internal and external politics of the Tajaran are shared between several major houses: - House Hadii - House Kaytam - House Sendai
Hadii is the largest and oldest house on Adhomai. It is the most peaceful and accommodating of the houses and argues for union with human society. "He will do what is best for the Tajaran people. If that means yielding to the demands of humanity, then he will do it."
Kaytam is the second largest house. House Kaytam is the main military force of Adhomai and oversees most matters of security for the homeworld and for Tajaran living away from it. It is the most distrustful of the houses. "They have seen too much in their long lives, but above all they know one thing: better to die than to remain a slave. Never again."
Sendai is the last of the major houses. Its main work is archaeological expeditions into the unexplored and ruined lands of Adhomai. Towards humans, Sendai keeps a policy of coexistence, neither drawing close nor turning humanity away. "We long for peaceful coexistence between the Tajaran and humanity... but we cannot let them rule Adhomai. We must stand firmly on our own feet. If we do not, our culture will never regain its former glory."
